# Selective re-check against re-checking every item (generated by analysis/fu_recheck_vs_all.py)

**Post hoc, exploratory** (DEVIATIONS D19). Offline replay of existing per-item outputs: re-check the share k of items first in a ranking, keep a0 elsewhere. Every ranking is rebuilt as in `analysis/fu_recheck_cost.py` (math) and the frozen `analysis/mc_results.py` (MMLU-Pro), and their stored fixes, damages and estimates are reproduced exactly. Accuracy change against KEEP is in `reports/fu_05_recheck_cost.md` and `reports/v2_02_mc_results.md`, repeated here in the second table. 95 % cluster-bootstrap CIs, pp. Reading rule: "above ALL" only where the paired CI lies above zero; "above KEEP" only where the CI against a0 lies above zero.
